simple.meaning: שׁוֹעַ (Shôwaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Shoa , an Oriental people.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H7772. Shoa III. שׁוֺעַ proper name, of a people Ezek 23:23 usually identified with Assyrian Sutû, Sutî, nomads of Mesop. and (later) east of Tigris, Dl Pa 234 ff. COT on the passage Wkl KAT 3. 22 Dt Hast. DB KOA .

occurrences.englishText: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, princes and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.
